card.title: How to fix iPhone 8 with Grayed Out Speaker Button During Phone Call

source.title: How to fix iPhone 8 with Grayed Out Speaker Button During Phone Call

symptoms: speaker button greyed out in calls

claims.statement: Unlike iPhone 7 audio disease, a greyed-out speaker button on iPhone 8 is usually a corroded front camera flex (ALS/proximity); replacing that flex loses True Tone.

procedure: Unplug the front camera flex and test.
Clean or replace the flex (True Tone will be lost if replaced).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
